Organization.title: Organization
Organization.subtitle: Administer your organization — the account above your workspaces. These settings apply to every workspace in the organization.
Organization.noAccessBody: You need an organization owner or admin role to manage these settings.

OrgAi.title: AI provider
OrgAi.subtitle: Bring your own AI provider for this organization. Connex masks personal data before every model call, audits all outbound requests, and keeps AI off until you configure and enable a provider here.
OrgAi.enableDescription: Let members who hold the AI permission use AI features in this organization's workspaces.
OrgAi.bedrockModelIdHint: A Bedrock Claude model or inference-profile ID, e.g. anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0.
OrgAi.azureEndpointHint: Your Azure OpenAI resource URL, e.g. https://your-resource.openai.azure.com.
OrgAi.vertexRegionHint: A Vertex AI location, e.g. asia-northeast1 or us-central1.
OrgAi.serviceAccountJsonHint: Paste the JSON key file of a service account with Vertex AI access. Stored encrypted; never shown.
OrgAi.genericEndpointHint: An HTTPS endpoint implementing the OpenAI chat completions API, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1.
OrgAi.allowInternalDescription: Permit a private-network address over HTTP(S). Available only when the instance operator allows private AI endpoints.
OrgAi.attestLabel: Our provider agreement disallows training and long-term retention on submitted data
OrgAi.attestDescription: Confirm that your contract with the selected provider excludes model training and long-term retention of Connex data. Required before AI can be enabled.
OrgAi.credentialKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored credential. Stored encrypted; never shown.
OrgAi.saveFailed: Could not save the AI provider settings.
OrgAi.stepUpRequired: Recent sign-in required. Verify your identity in Settings → Security, then try again.
OrgAi.loadFailed: Could not load the AI provider settings.

OrgMembers.title: Administrators
OrgMembers.subtitle: People who can administer this organization — configure SSO, allowed domains, and manage administrators. Distinct from workspace membership.
OrgMembers.roleOwnerHint: Full control, including managing administrators and ownership.
OrgMembers.roleAdminHint: Administer org settings, but not administrators.
OrgMembers.removeConfirmBody: {name} will lose organization administrator access. Their workspace membership is unaffected.
OrgMembers.lastOwnerTooltip: An organization must keep at least one owner. Promote another owner first.
OrgMembers.addSubtitle: Grant an existing Connex account organization access by email. Owners can manage administrators; admins can configure settings.

OrgDomains.title: Allowed domains
OrgDomains.subtitle: Restrict who can be invited into any workspace in this organization. When set, every invite and join — links, email invites, and SSO — must match one of these email domains. Leave empty to allow any domain.
OrgDomains.label: Email domain
OrgDomains.empty: No domain restrictions — members can be invited from any email domain. Add a domain to restrict who can join workspaces in this organization.
OrgDomains.loadError: Couldn't load allowed domains. Refresh to try again.

OrgAudit.title: Audit log
OrgAudit.subtitle: Organization-level governance events — SSO configuration, administrators, and allowed-domain changes. Workspace record changes appear in each workspace's own audit log.
